snippet.title: Sovereign Tower - Reveal Trailer | Coming August 2026!
snippet.description:
Play the demo on itch.io now: https://wildwits.itch.io/sovereign-tower
 
Welcome to Sovereign Tower! Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.
 
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4113940/Sovereign_Tower/
Join the Sovereign Tower community on Discord: https://discord.gg/ee3M8mhTcB
Follow on X: https://x.com/SovereignTower 
Follow on Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/sovereigntower.bsky.social
